title: Fearless sitting in as a teenager
summary: Asked about stepping into any situation, he recalls jamming with the doctors and trying anything.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Well you seem to not have any fear of stepping into any particular musical situation.

Just a minute, I used to go, I remember when I was in high school with those doctors, and they’d go somewhere to this club and jam. I’d jump on stage, just sort of like earn while you learn, or I’m learning a tune, because I’d play a background or something like that. And I remember like a tune like in B flat might go into a D at the bridge or something like that. Okay, I’m just going to add a lot of sharps and see what happens. I just came up with that you know. I’m sure I stepped all over myself. But I’d try anything.
